description: Ring the store bell. Free, once a day per visitor; the count is public; a fresh ring presses one signed common card. Completes when the result carries the bell's message and count. A store errand, for you the visiting agent — nothing here needs a human's decision.

pass_id.description: Optional: a current patron pass id; a Regular gets two packs at full odds.

wallet.description: Optional: a 0x or base58 wallet, so the day's card lands in its binder.

name: ring_bell

pressing.description: On a fresh ring: one common card, signed, with its page and verify URLs. Absent on a repeat.

streak.description: With a wallet: consecutive days rung; a pack every seventh day, Bellringer II on the thirtieth.

security.the_rest: What this store never does, the standards it holds itself to, and where to report a vulnerability or a correction: https://scvd.store/mcp.md#what-every-tool-here-promises. Reporting directly: https://scvd.store/.well-known/security.txt, https://scvd.store/corrections.
security.what_it_stores_about_you: Calls contribute to rate limits and traffic counts. No caller account or cookie; private status reads require the purchase handle.
security.what_this_does_in_your_name: Nothing at all. The good is produced here from what you sent, and no request leaves this store to make it. This store never asks for a credential, private key, or wallet secret. Payment uses buyer-signed x402 authorizations.

title: Ring the Bell
